# Vendored browser dependency

`socket.io.min.js` is Socket.IO client v4.7.2, downloaded from the official
Socket.IO CDN so the kiosk keeps working without an Internet connection.

- Source: https://cdn.socket.io/4.7.2/socket.io.min.js
